# FormalToolchain

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An integrated software pipeline that translates SNN models into formal representations (e.g., Markov chains) and applies abstraction-based model checking to verify probabilistic properties. This provides a practical, automated path from neuromorphic design to verified implementation, essential for adopting iNEST in reliable, real-world computing architectures.
